Flow.description: 12/29/2025 (KL) - Remaining Updates 12/23/2025 (BW) - Adding a fetch of the service contract to use it's details in the flow. Also added Coverage Type to the Billing Type default, to pull from the contract if there is one

formulas.description:
12/29/2025 - Formula to pull in service contract coverage variations to be used in billing type via converted value based on the following:
Variation between US and UK, but In US, coverage type C should have: If coverage type: “PM” – if break fix, default T&M; if PM work order – under contract If coverage type: “PM Plus” – if break fix, default T&M; if PM work order, under contract If coverage type: “Full service pro pull” – auto under contract (all work types) If coverage type: “Full service inside territory” – auto contract (all work types) If coverage type: “Full service outside territory” – auto contract (all work types) If no contract found OR none of the above value, default “T&M”
